title: NotePal
subtitle: Note-taking and study app
home_summary: Built and deployed a full-stack study app with AI note generation, flashcards, quizzes, and RAG chat.
detail_summary: Created a Next.js and TypeScript frontend with a Notion-style editor and a Flask REST API that orchestrates OCR, ASR, and LLM pipelines using Whisper, YOLO, LLM APIs, Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Pinecone.
problem: Students need to turn mixed study material into usable notes and practice materials without losing time to manual formatting.
solution: Automated note, flashcard, quiz, and chat workflows from multimodal input with per-user data isolation.
impact: Cut study time by 67% and shipped on Vercel with CI/CD.

title: Clair
subtitle: Automotive file organizer
home_summary: Built a Python and Bash desktop app to automate file cleanup for automotive workflows.
detail_summary: Created a local file organization utility that automates folder cleanup and reduces repeated manual sorting.
problem: Manual file cleanup is repetitive and error-prone when folders accumulate inconsistent names and structures.
solution: Used Python and Bash automation to organize files into repeatable folder structures.
